text.en: Back again? I'm beginning to charge myself for these visits.
text.zh-CN: 又来了？再这样，我都想给自己收诊费了。

text.en: We're looking for a Nightshade Blossom. Someone needs an antidote.
text.zh-CN: 我们在找夜影花，有人等着配解药。

text.en: Flowers? I run a respectable practice.
text.zh-CN: 花？我开的可是正经诊所。

text.en: Then help us. The champion at Winter Cottage was poisoned.
text.zh-CN: 那就帮帮忙。冬日小屋的老勇士中毒了。

text.en: No blossoms here. Try a florist.
text.zh-CN: 这里没花，去找花匠吧。

text.en: Then why is there one behind the counter?
text.zh-CN: 那柜台后面这株是什么？

text.en: Ah. That one. You should have left it alone.
text.zh-CN: 啊，那株。你们不该碰它。

text.en: Step back. He's reaching for it!
text.zh-CN: 退后，他要动手！

text.en: Please! I'm much more useful alive.
text.zh-CN: 饶命！活着的我更有用。

text.en: You've tried robbing us and poisoning us. That's quite a résumé.
text.zh-CN: 抢过我们，又想下毒。你这履历真够丰富。

text.en: I know a secret about the champion!
text.zh-CN: 我知道老勇士的秘密！

text.en: Then talk.
text.zh-CN: 那就说。

text.en: Promise you'll spare me first. That's my final offer.
text.zh-CN: 先答应放过我，这是我的最后条件。

text.en: You tried to poison us. You're done hurting people.
text.zh-CN: 你还想下毒害人。到此为止了。

text.en: Wait—!
text.zh-CN: 等等——！

text.en: We have the blossom. Let's get back to Winter Cottage.
text.zh-CN: 花拿到了，快回冬日小屋。

text.en: You live. Tell us what you know.
text.zh-CN: 留你一命。把知道的说出来。

text.en: The champion has been very quiet about an old duel.
text.zh-CN: 老勇士一直不肯提一场旧决斗。

text.en: A traveler died from poison after fighting him. I saw the blade.
text.zh-CN: 一个旅人在和他交手后中毒身亡。我见过那把兵器。

text.en: Then why haven't you said anything?
text.zh-CN: 那你怎么现在才说？

text.en: Nobody had asked quite this firmly.
text.zh-CN: 以前没人问得这么坚决。

text.en: You're coming with us. You'll tell him exactly what you told us.
text.zh-CN: 跟我们走，当着他的面把这些话再说一遍。

text.en: In front of witnesses? Absolutely. I like witnesses.
text.zh-CN: 有证人在场？当然好，我最喜欢有证人了。

text.en: We have the blossom. Let's get back to Winter Cottage.
text.zh-CN: 花拿到了，快回冬日小屋。

text.en: The apothecary may be lying. We help first, then ask questions.
text.zh-CN: 药师可能在说谎。先救人，再问清楚。

text.en: We're back. Gerda has the antidote.
text.zh-CN: 我们回来了，格尔达带来了解药。

text.en: Thank you.
text.zh-CN: 多谢。

text.en: Hold still. This will sting. (She applies the antidote and covers his eyes.)
text.zh-CN: 别动，会有点刺痛。（她敷上药，包好他的眼睛。）

text.en: You weren't exaggerating.
text.zh-CN: 你还真没夸张。

text.en: A traveler died after a duel with you. Was poison involved?
text.zh-CN: 有个旅人在和你决斗后死去，和毒有关吗？

text.en: Tell him about the blade.
text.zh-CN: 把兵器的事告诉他。

text.en: We exchanged weapons. I wounded him. He died from poison I never knew was there.
text.zh-CN: 我们交换过兵器。我伤了他，他却中了我根本不知道的毒。

text.en: And you still don't know how it got there?
text.zh-CN: 你到现在也不知道毒是怎么沾上去的？

text.en: There. He admitted it. What else do you need?
text.zh-CN: 听见了？他承认了，还用问吗？

text.en: I admitted what happened. Not what you're implying.
text.zh-CN: 我承认发生过的事，不是你暗示的那回事。

text.en: You wanted to win. Poison made that easy.
text.zh-CN: 你想赢，下毒就容易多了。

text.en: No. He was my friend.
text.zh-CN: 不。他是我的朋友。

text.en: Then someone is leaving out a very important part.
text.zh-CN: 那就有人漏掉了最重要的部分。

text.en: You're wasting time. Finish him before he can fool you.
text.zh-CN: 别浪费时间，在他骗过你们之前动手。

text.en: I won't stop you from asking questions. I want answers too.
text.zh-CN: 我不会拦着你们调查，我也想知道答案。

text.en: Then we find out who poisoned that blade.
text.zh-CN: 那就找出是谁在兵器上下的毒。

text.en: Someone wants us blaming each other instead of asking questions.
text.zh-CN: 有人想让我们互相责怪，而不是问清真相。

text.en: Take this Frontier Cleave Manual. It belonged to my friend. I hope it helps you find the truth.
text.zh-CN: 带上这本边境重斩手册吧。它曾属于我的朋友，但愿能帮你们查明真相。

text.en: Thank you. We'll follow the evidence.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢。我们会顺着证据查下去。

prompt.en: What do you do with the apothecary? Both choices provide the blossom.
prompt.zh-CN: 如何处置药师？两种选择都能拿到花。

prompt.en: Kill the champion on the apothecary's word? Attacking costs 4 Morality and starts a fight.
prompt.zh-CN: 仅凭药师的话就杀死老勇士？动手会扣4道德并进入战斗。

杀死了江湖混混阎基。.en: Killed the apothecary and recovered a Nightshade Blossom. Return to Winter Cottage.
杀死了江湖混混阎基。.zh-CN: 杀死药师，拿到一株夜影花。返回冬日小屋。

从阎基口中得知，苗人凤是胡斐的杀父仇人。.en: Spared the apothecary. He joined us and accused the champion of poisoning a traveler in an old duel. Return to Winter Cottage with the blossom and hear the champion's account.
从阎基口中得知，苗人凤是胡斐的杀父仇人。.zh-CN: 放过药师。他加入队伍，指控老勇士在旧决斗中毒害旅人。带花返回冬日小屋，听听老勇士的说法。

得知苗人凤是胡斐的杀父仇人，但此事需要进一步调查原因。.en: Heard the champion's account of a poisoned duel. He gave us a Frontier Cleave Manual. The truth still needs investigating.
得知苗人凤是胡斐的杀父仇人，但此事需要进一步调查原因。.zh-CN: 听过老勇士对中毒决斗的解释，获得边境重斩手册。真相仍待调查。
